annotations.title: Add, change, remove (retire) or restore one pharmacy in the directory with the expected version

description: Add, change, remove (retire) or restore one pharmacy in the directory with the expected version. Save sends every field; empty fields are cleared. Calls stay off until call_allowed is true, and need a phone number. Retire turns calls off and keeps the record and its history. Starts no call.

entry.description: Every field of the pharmacy, for save. Fields you leave empty are cleared.

call_allowed.description: Summer places calls only after a person turns this on.

hours.description: Local opening hours per weekday: { open: "HH:MM", close: "HH:MM" } or "closed". Leave a day out when its hours are unknown.

identifiers_needed.description: What the pharmacy asks for, such as patient name, date of birth, medication and prescriber.

location.description: City, state or branch. Use an empty string when there is one location.

menu_path.description: Keys to press in the phone menu, in order, such as "2,1".

notes.description: Notes from past calls, such as the best time to call.

phone_source.description: Where a person checked the number, such as the pharmacy's website.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the pharmacy's hours, such as America/Chicago.

id.description: The pharmacy to change. Leave out to add a new pharmacy.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

operation.description: save adds a pharmacy (no id, version 0) or replaces all fields of one; retire removes it from use and turns calls off; restore brings a removed one back with calls off.

version.description: The version you read, or 0 for a new pharmacy. A newer saved version refuses the change.
